acceptance_predicates.description: Every public command family, alias, routed lifecycle, and meaningful user-observable operation is inventoried and classified as immediate, bounded, or indeterminate.
Every eligible human status/progress update uses the shared reporter; no ad-hoc public status/progress write remains.
Bounded operations provide real totals/completion or relevant substeps; unbounded operations explicitly use truthful indeterminate updates rather than invented percentages or ETAs.
Success, failure, warning, partial, cancellation, and reconciliation paths each finish with an appropriate concise state line and retain diagnostic detail.
Every command route remains completely free of human status/update/progress output in --json and -q modes.

definition_of_done: Executable route matrix covers fast, long-running, failed, warning, partial, cancelled, redirected, quiet, and JSON behavior for every public command family.
No direct status/progress rendering remains outside the reporter and its approved terminal adapters.
Independent review, exact-head checks, signed merge, and exact-main evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1769 authoritative public-command and diagnostic completeness gate.
AR-1772 delayed human step-progress reporter and deterministic harness.

outputs.description: Every eligible public ASB operation reports structured real progress through the common helper.

gates.description: Mechanical inventory proves every public route and eligible operation is instrumented or explicitly exempted as an input/protocol boundary.
Executable route matrix proves status/progress behavior for terminal, redirected, quiet, and JSON modes.
Focused tests prove bounded and indeterminate operations feed and render only truthful progress information.
